purpose: Teach: デリー/サウジアラビア/ユナイテッド/ダライ/家康/ジュネーブ/トロイ/台北

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でデリー習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku — you learned about Delhi in social studies, right?
lines.style: Playful accusation, teasing lilt. Quick attack on his name. Slight smile in the voice. Testing to see if he notices.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でサウジアラビア習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about Saudi Arabia in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Caught-red-handed deflection. Turns it back on her with matching teasing energy. Light, not defensive. Grinning.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、マンチェスター・ユナイテッドの試合観てたな
lines.en: Riku — you were watching that Manchester United match the other day.
lines.style: Gotcha tone. Knowing. Catches him in a moment of normalcy. Gentle tease, not mean. Notices what he does when he thinks no one's looking.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ダライ・ラマの本読んでたな、桜
lines.en: You were reading that Dalai Lama book, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Mirror her tone back. Equal observation, equal noticing. Quiet satisfaction in catching her being sincere. Unflustered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で徳川家康習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku — you studied Tokugawa Ieyasu in social studies, right?
lines.style: Back to the pattern, relentless. Slight acceleration. She's building the game, seeing if he'll keep matching. Grin in her voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でジュネーブ条約習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned the Geneva Convention in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Steady rhythm, matching her persistence. Not falling behind. Eyes on her now. Both of them playing the same game, both aware of it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でトロイ戦争習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku — you studied the Trojan War in social studies, didn't you?
lines.style: One more volley. She's looking for something — a break in the pattern or a deeper admission. Softer edge underneath the teasing now.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、台北旅行行きたがってたな、桜
lines.en: You wanted to go to Taipei, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Tempo slows slightly. Drops the social-studies pattern. This one lands differently — gentler, closer. He's noticed something real about her. Warm underneath.
